message: Last week, I decided it was time to check our smoke alarms (you know, the ones that always seem to beep at the most inconvenient times?). I started a family group chat to rally the troops, and suddenly we were sharing tips and giggles about our own kitchen mishaps. Turns out, my brother once mistook a smoke alarm for a cooking timer! 😂 It was a great reminder that keeping our homes safe can be a family affair — and a little laughter goes a long way. Have you chatted about fire safety with your family lately?
